game_title: Off By One Autopsy – Dry Well Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Dry Well, a nearly dry well: the sand ranger must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dry Well: a nearly dry well
core_gameplay_loop: In Dry Well, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the sand ranger ahead. Then check the autopsy value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the supply tent by solving code steps involving autopsy that move the sand ranger forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the supply tent first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 8 (extended tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Off By One Autopsy' (Week 9 slot 6), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Dry Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how autopsy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sand wyrms in Dry Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
